# Kedel

> > Kedel manufactures maintenance-free recycled plastic lumber, decking, fencing, benches, and outdoor products from HDPE and mixed plastics as sustainable wood alternatives.

Kedel Limited is a UK-based recycling company specializing in transforming waste plastics into durable construction materials and outdoor furniture. Their product range includes plastic lumber boards, decking, fencing systems, children's play equipment, and street furniture, all designed to be rot-proof and maintenance-free alternatives to traditional timber.

## Key Topics

- Recycled Plastic Lumber
- HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene)
- Maintenance-Free Products
- Plastic Wood Alternatives
- Mixed Plastic Boards
- Sustainable Construction Materials
- Recycled Plastic Decking
- Plastic Fencing Systems
- UV-Stable Outdoor Products
- Eco-Friendly Garden Products
- CNC Cutting Services
- Rot-Proof Building Materials
- Children's Play Equipment
- Garden Furniture
- Environmental Sustainability

- [Recycled Plastic Wood - 100 x 40mm](https://www.kedel.co.uk/recycled-plastic-wood/recycled-plastic-wood-100mm-x-40mm.html): 100x40mm recycled plastic wood profile with UV protection
